Beijing tower plane collision prompts questions about China's response

A plane collided with a tower in Beijing, causing visible damage. China has reportedly removed traces of the incident and has not disclosed the cause. The event has raised questions about the incident's nature and potential safety concerns regarding low-altitude flights in China.
